summary.why: Article 1(1) lists points a-p of Vietnamese lettering (a b c d đ e g h i k l m n o p) = 15 provisions of the Law, not 16.

fix.value: Main implementing decree of Viet Nam's Law on Artificial Intelligence, detailing a number of its articles, from the one-stop AI portal and national database of AI systems to risk classification, conformity assessment and management of high-risk systems, controlled testing and impact assessment of AI used by state bodies. Providers classify systems before use; deployers reclassify with the provider when changes create new or higher risk. Providers must mark AI-generated audio, images and video in machine-readable form, and deployers must label content that imitates real people or events. Serious incidents must be reported within 72 hours or 5 working days, depending on the case.

evidence.quote: 1. Nghị định này quy định chỉ tiết một số điều của Luật Trí tuệ nhân tạo bao gồm:

summary_claims.claim: 'detailing 16 of its provisions': Art. 1(1) lists 15 (a-p, no f/j/w/z)
Serious incidents: preliminary report within 72 hours (urgent) or 05 working days (others), full report in 15 days (Art. 19(3)-(4))
Providers mark AI audio/image/video in machine-readable form; deployers label content imitating real person's appearance or voice (Arts 17(1), 18(2))
Art. 4(3)(d) exempts internal Party systems and state-secret/defence/security lists from portal notification
Art. 5(6) existing test/conformity results need not be repeated
